scheme_name: Annual Tour to the Differently Abled Persons
other_conditions: Must be a native/resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry for at least 5 years
Disability of 40% or above is required
Applicant must not have performed the tour in the past ten years
Applicant must not be affected by any contagious diseases
Application can be made only after notification in local newspapers
Applicant must not be a Government servant
Parents of the applicant must not be Government servants
Applicant must have registered his/her name in the Anganwadi Centre
benefits_summary: One free tour to various places each year.
